say:3:1321725001:1.text: W-what's going on?! The castle looks completely restored!
say:3:1321725001:1.source_cn: 这、这是怎么回事？！城堡怎么突然恢复正常了？！

say:4:1321725002:1.text: Yeah... It wasn't like this when we left!
say:4:1321725002:1.source_cn: 是啊……我们离开时明明不是这样的！

say:5:1321725003:1.text: Restored, you say? What was the castle like before?
say:5:1321725003:1.source_cn: “恢复正常”……？之前城堡里是什么样子？

say:6:1321725004:1.text: Um, it's kinda hard to explain... Back when the Hypogean's influence was strong, the castle's interior was... well, distorted.
say:6:1321725004:1.source_cn: 唔，很难和你形容……之前受到了恶魔的影响，城堡内部的空...

say:7:1321725005:1.text: We were walking on these giant snowflake-shaped stone slabs floating in the air, and beneath them was just this endless void. It didn't feel real at all!
say:7:1321725005:1.source_cn: 那时我们脚下踩的是巨大的雪花状石板，石板仿佛悬浮在空中...

say:8:1321725006:1.text: But now... now it's all fixed, like nothing ever happened!
say:8:1321725006:1.source_cn: 但是现在，现在突然恢复到了正常的状态……！

say:9:1321725007:0.text: Hmm... It must be that when the Frost Furie was sealed by <style="stress"><player_name></style>, her sinister influence on the castle was undone. The cleansing has restored everything to its natural state. Isn't that a good sign?

say:11:1321725008:1.source_cn: 突如其来的变化……确实需要警惕。

say:12:1321725010:1.text: Could it be that the Frost Furie's magic was so powerful that even after being sealed, it took time for its effects to fade?
say:12:1321725010:1.source_cn: 难道是冰之恶魔的力量过强，被封印后，魔法效应过了一段时...

say:13:1321725011:1.text: Regardless of the answer, we must remain vigilant.
say:13:1321725011:1.source_cn: 无论如何，既然情况有变，当提高警惕才是。

say:14:1321725012:1.text: Our immediate priority is to find Captain Rodrigo. If the castle has transformed so drastically, let us hope he has not been affected by the changes...
say:14:1321725012:1.source_cn: 当务之急是找到侍卫长。但愿他没有被城堡的变化所影响……

choice:10:0:1.text: It didn't look like this earlier!
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 我们之前离开时还不是这样！
choice:10:0:1.male: It didn't look like this earlier!
choice:10:0:1.female: It didn't look like this earlier!

say:16:1321725009:1.text: Strange indeed. Such a delay in the restoration... it raises questions.
say:16:1321725009:1.male: Strange indeed. Such a delay in the restoration... it raises questions.
say:16:1321725009:1.female: Strange indeed. Such a delay in the restoration... it raises questions.

choice:10:1:2.text: This didn't happen during the seal.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 封印恶魔后城堡也没有恢复原状
choice:10:1:2.male: This didn't happen during the seal.
